def factor_vwap_sma_vol_regime(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    d = 20
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    vwap = (close * volume).rolling(window=d, min_periods=d).sum() / volume.rolling(window=d, min_periods=d).sum()
    sma = close.rolling(window=d, min_periods=d).mean()
    raw_signal = (vwap - sma) / close
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(volume, window=20, high_threshold=1.5, low_threshold=0.6)
    clipped_vol_ratio = vol_ratio.clip(0.5, 2.0)
    factor = raw_signal * clipped_vol_ratio
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    factor.name = "factor_vwap_sma_vol_regime"
    return factor
description: Crossover combining VWAP-SMA divergence (primary mechanism from parent 1, cand_price_vol_coh_002 / agentdailytrend_g0_c2 lineage) with an EMA-based volume regime filter (lightweight modifier borrowed from parent 2's volume ratio concept, enhanced via alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime for faster adaptation). The raw VWAP-SMA signal normalized by close is scaled by the clipped vol_ratio to de-emphasize low-volume signals, aiming to preserve strong RankIC and RankICIR while improving IC through more responsive volume filtration.
